svg.title: OLS attention weights are signed and wiggly
svg.desc: Weights omega_i = x_j' (X'X)^-1 x_i that a degree-5 polynomial OLS gives each of 400 training points, for three test points x_j = 0, 0.8 and 1.05. At x_j = 0 the weights are a broad low bump with small negative side lobes; at 0.8 the bump moves toward the edge; at 1.05, just outside the training range, weights are several times larger, alternate in sign across the whole interval, and rise steeply at the right edge, nearest the test point, while also putting weight on points far from it. The dashed grey line is the smooth Gaussian-kernel weight for x_j = 0 with bandwidth 0.15, which is never negative.
svg.text: Who does each test point attend to? Degree-5 polynomial OLS, N = 400
